title.narrative: To accelerate the reduction of TB, Leprosy and lung disease burden through provision of people-centered, universally accessible, acceptable and affordable quality services in Kenya - Kenya (01-Jan-2018-30-Jun-2021)

description.narrative: Kenya, Tuberculosis, The National Treasury & Economic Planning of the Government of Kenya (TNT)This program has the following goals: To accelerate the reduction of TB, Leprosy and lung disease burden through provision of people-centered, universally accessible, acceptable and affordable quality services in Kenya.. The objectives of this program are: Sustain the gains in the context of a newly devolved health system. Intensify efforts to find “missing” cases. Reduce transmission. Prevent active disease and morbidity. Enhance the quality of care for chronic lung diseases
